Things of Beauty: Super Smash Bros. as Spectator Sport

If anyone was inspired to try out Smash, I highly recommend you check out Project M. It's an extensive mod for Brawl that makes the game more like competitive Melee, and in addition balances out all of the characters. In Project M, every character is debatably viable at top tier competition. There's custom skins, custom music, and custom stages.

All you need to get started is a North American Wii, a Brawl disc, and 2GB SD card. Alternatively you can use Dolphin and play the game on your PC at whatever resolution you want. There's online modes for both the Wii and PC versions. Here is the very active reddit sub that the dev's frequent if you have questions or want to immerse yourself in the community, or you can use the smashboards forums if you refuse to ever visit reddit again.

It's super fun at ultra tryhard competitive level and casual night-in with some friends. Project M is seriously one of the favorite games and I give it my highest recommendations.
